entities.name: Damian of Tarsus

entities.summary: Damian of Tarsus, surnamed Ghulam Yazman, was a Byzantine Greek convert to Islam, governor of Tarsus in 896–897 and one of the main leaders of naval raids against the Eastern Roman Empire in the early 10th century.
